name: irac-diis-from-cg
rationale: The IRAC/FULL_ALL/CG/0.05 recovery reached SCF convergence at4.1e-7 and E=-754.20417257342Ha, but MPI finalization then aborted with a leaking-communicator assertion and execution/time exits1. Do not accept that execution. Start one separate IRAC/FULL_ALL/DIIS/0.05 execution from its exact preserved final complex-k-point WFN using the same Terok CPU binary and CPU Skala model. The analogous urea molecular DIIS restart completed cleanly in one step after the same CG finalization failure. This tests transfer of the converged crystal state and a clean non-CG completion, not an unchanged retry from the earlier stationary DIIS seed. Preserve the full3x3x3 symmetry reduction, coordinates, basis, grids, cutoffs, D3 and EPS_SCF5e-7. Require newest-block convergence, normal end, no later abort, exits0 and complete provenance; do not suppress assertions or rebuild the frozen binary.
